document_title: Semi-Annual Economic Development Report on Large Load Additions in Advanced Stages of Development, UPDATE Spring 2026 - PUBLIC
how_obtained: Downloaded the PDF from the NCUC STAR document handler https://starw1.ncuc.gov/NCUC/ViewFile.aspx?Id=<file-guid>, which is the link the commission's own document-detail page points at. starw1.ncuc.gov sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge that refuses plain HTTP clients (403 for curl and for the plain fetch tool), so the session was driven with a real Chrome browser under Playwright, which passes the challenge normally; the PDF bytes were then read out of that same browser session. Converted the PDF to text with pdfminer.six extract_text(). The text is saved exactly as pdfminer emitted it - no reflow, no de-hyphenation, no ligature or soft-hyphen repair, form feeds, margin line numbers, column-split Q/A markers and OCR noise all left in place.
corpus_note: Instalment 4 of 4, and the REVISED half of the version pair: this is the same Spring 2026 report re-filed as an update on 2026-07-09. Pair it with nc-e100-sub208a-semiannual-large-load-report-spring-2026-public for original-vs-revision comparison. Public version; sealed ESAs excluded.
